name: Editorial Index Rows
description: Oversized editorial nav rows separated by hairline rules. Hovering or focusing a row sweeps the label from muted grey to full ink with a background-clip text fill, slides the trailing arrow in from the left with a spring overshoot, and tints the row background subtly. Pure CSS, keyboard focus mirrors hover.
usage: Include styles.css, then drop a nav with a ul.eir where each li holds an a.eir-row containing span.eir-num, span.eir-label and the span.eir-arrow inline SVG (copy the rows from index.html). Retheme by overriding the --eir-* custom properties on .eir or any ancestor.
source: Pattern seen on https://coffee-tech.com (Awwwards SOTD by MAKETHECUT and Or Halevi), implemented from scratch
